ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
fixed2tab converts fixed-width column text into TSV, detecting the column
boundaries automatically by locating character positions that are blank in
every record.

Legacy scientific codes still emit results as fixed-width columns, which
delimiter-based tools cannot read: multi-token cells are shattered, and rows
where a sparse column is blank have every later field shifted left. Neither
failure raises an error.

Every run writes the table, a geometry report and every unparsed line, so
that table rows plus rejected lines always equals input lines.
about.summary: Convert fixed-width text files to tabular (TSV)

name: fixed2tab
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.1.0"

package:
  name: fixed2tab
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/dasch-swiss/rdu-fixed2tab/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4348c6574bf3093d9c30ac822ee66691048e8dd48f1e60ee270f1e05fb8b0cf5

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - fixed2tab = fixed2tab.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - fixed2tab
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - fixed2tab --version
      - fixed2tab --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/dasch-swiss/rdu-fixed2tab
  repository: https://github.com/dasch-swiss/rdu-fixed2tab
  documentation: https://github.com/dasch-swiss/rdu-fixed2tab/blob/main/docs/running-fixed2tab.md
  summary: Convert fixed-width text files to tabular (TSV)
  description: |
    fixed2tab converts fixed-width column text into TSV, detecting the column
    boundaries automatically by locating character positions that are blank in
    every record.

    Legacy scientific codes still emit results as fixed-width columns, which
    delimiter-based tools cannot read: multi-token cells are shattered, and rows
    where a sparse column is blank have every later field shifted left. Neither
    failure raises an error.

    Every run writes the table, a geometry report and every unparsed line, so
    that table rows plus rejected lines always equals input lines.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - gautschr
    - jnussbaum
